calls.thesis: Palantir could be one of the biggest winners from turning AI into real-world business decisions (revenue expected up 83% this year, ~50% next year; $3.4B operating/free cash flow, $2B+ cash), but valuation is the big risk at 163x earnings / 80x sales — he wants it down to around $160 or even $150 a share before jumping in too much and is not loading up at the current price.
